step_1_leaf_semantics.reasoning: The scenario id 'syndra_derived_order_39' names the F3 derived-ability-order family (data/worklists/f3-task.md: 'OPTIMAL EVENT-ORDER ENGINE (F3) … derive the order on the fly from the atomized data'), whose ranking signal is 'total_raw / effective cooldown × AoE weight'. The leaf therefore sits in the rotation-resolver readout, and the 'aoe' node is the per-ability area-of-effect signal keyed by ability slot. The only ambiguity left is which integer quantity the node stores; I bounded that by elimination below.
step_1_leaf_semantics.note: The scenario definition itself lives outside the permitted evidence tree (no 'coupled_scenarios' or 'syndra_derived_order_39' string exists anywhere under data/), so the semantics were pinned by elimination from the cached data rather than read off a schema.

step_2_is_an_aoe_entry_for_W_warranted.claim: Yes. Syndra W is unambiguously an area-of-effect damage ability in the cached wiki text.
step_2_is_an_aoe_entry_for_W_warranted.evidence: spellEffects = 'Aoe'; effectRadius = 225; recast description 'dealing magic damage to them and nearby enemies once they land. All targets hit are slowed by 25%'. An 'aoe' map that omits W is therefore wrong-in-kind; adding a W entry is correct-in-kind.

step_3_eliminate_the_readings_under_whic.reading: 5 = W damage (raw or post-mitigation) in the rotation
step_3_eliminate_the_readings_under_whic.work: W raw at 0 AP = 70/100/130/160/190 by rank; post-mitigation vs 50 MR via m(R)=100/(100+R) gives 46.7/66.7/86.7/106.7/126.7. The 60-splinter Transcendent bonus only adds true damage on top. No W damage figure at any rank, any AP, any resistance is anywhere near 5 — the smallest possible non-zero W damage packet in the cache is 70 raw. Reading excluded.

step_3_eliminate_the_readings_under_whic.reading: 5 = number of W casts in the scenario window
step_3_eliminate_the_readings_under_whic.work: Cast epochs are 0, c, 2c, … (math-foundations §1.1), so 5 casts require T ≥ 4·c_eff. With c = [12,11,10,9,8] and effective_cd = cd·100/(100+AH): at 0 AH rank 5 needs T ≥ 32.0 s; at 50 AH, 21.3 s; even at 100 AH, 16.0 s. The corpus fight windows are 'one_rotation' (exactly one cast per ability) and short timed fights (data/practice-corpus/scenarios.json uses one_rotation and t=10 readouts), so 5 W casts is unreachable. Reading excluded.

step_4_surviving_readings_all_evaluate_t.reading: AoE breadth / targets hit (the 'AoE weight' factor of the F3 ranking formula, expressed as targets)
step_4_surviving_readings_all_evaluate_t.work: The cached W entry carries no target cap (no maxTargets/targetCap field; collisionRadius null; projectile FALSE) and the wiki text puts no limit on 'nearby enemies'. An uncapped AoE against an enemy team is therefore bounded only by the 5-champion team size ⇒ 5.

step_4_surviving_readings_all_evaluate_t.reading: W ability rank used by the derived order
step_4_surviving_readings_all_evaluate_t.work: W's leveling arrays have exactly 5 entries (damage [70,100,130,160,190]; cost [60,70,80,90,100]; cooldown [12,11,10,9,8]) ⇒ max rank 5, which is the rank a level-18/20 skill order assigns to a maxed basic ability (18 points = 5/5/5/3).
Cached wiki text, verbatim: 'holds the target near her for 5 seconds'.

independent_computation.conclusion: Every reading of this leaf that survives the numeric elimination evaluates to exactly 5, and the readings that would contradict 5 (damage, cast count) are arithmetically impossible for Syndra W in this corpus. The prior state — the leaf absent — is affirmatively wrong for an ability the cache flags spellEffects='Aoe' with a 225-unit effect radius and 'damage to them and nearby enemies' text, so <absent> cannot be defended.

residual_uncertainty: The exact unit of the 'aoe' node (targets vs. rank vs. seconds) could not be read from the permitted evidence tree, because no scenario/schema definition for 'coupled_scenarios' exists under data/. The verdict does not depend on resolving it: all admissible units land on 5, and the two units that would not land on 5 were excluded by arithmetic on the cached values.

verdict_detail.why_old_is_wrong: Syndra W is an AoE damage ability in the cached source data (spellEffects 'Aoe', effectRadius 225, 'damage to them and nearby enemies'); omitting it from the rotation's aoe node under-represents it in the F3 ranking signal total_raw / effective_cd × AoE weight.
